$comment: Geo's declarations on the kernel (lib/places.js). The place kind, the place tree and its identifier schemes are data: a new level (a planet, an ocean, a district, a shelf) is a node of this kind or a new kind, never code. Every write to a country or subdivision goes to the kernel first, in the same transaction as its master row; the boot pass only imports rows the kernel has never seen. A place's currency and locale are not facts of the place: they are settings owned by Value and Expression, assigned at the place's node and answered by the resolver; `column` names the field a write carries them in, and the legacy column an import reads them from on an install that predates the place tree; master.retiredColumns are dropped from the country table once their values are on the kernel.
